title: PROPOSED ACQUISITION BY WESTLANDS HEIGHTS LIMITED OF 99.9998 PERCENT SHARES IN HARLEYS (T) LIMITED
title_sw: PROPOSED ACQUISITION BY WESTLANDS HEIGHTS LIMITED OF 99.9998 PERCENT SHARES IN HARLEYS (T) LIMITED
text:
Westlands Heights Limited and Harleys (T) Limited notified the Fair Competition commission (“FCC” or where context permit “Commission”) that Westlands Heights Limited has reached a definitive agreement to purchase 99.9998 percent shares in Harleys (T) Limited.
The relevant market was defined as the importation and sell (wholesale and retail) of pharmaceutical products and medical devices in Tanzania.
Based on the analysis it was concluded that, pre- and post-merger scenarios will remain the same for both perspectives of Section 5 (6) (a) and (b) and thus having no possibility of either creating or strengthening a position of dominance in the relevant market. The merger was approved.
